note: Cost/quality measures for the four cold-reader trials. TWO INDEPENDENT COST SOURCES ARE KEPT SEPARATE because they measure different things and disagree; neither is 'the' cost of a mode.

harness_telemetry.source: agent-harness reported subagent_tokens / tool_uses / duration_ms per trial
harness_telemetry.measured_by: harness, not by the answer artifact
harness_telemetry.caveat: n=2 per mode. Variance within an arm is large (baseline 15157 vs 42348), so no mean difference here is statistically meaningful. These are totals for a full isolated context including the identical TASK.md prompt.

by_mode.verdict: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY — see caveat. Direction favours the capsule arm but the baseline arm's own spread (15k-42k) is larger than the between-arm gap.

self_reported_probe_counts.source: the answer artifact's own probe_count field — a SELF-REPORT, not harness-measured
self_reported_probe_counts.observation: Direction is OPPOSITE to token cost: capsule readers self-reported ~10x MORE probes while using fewer tokens. Plausible reading: the capsule told them which ground was unverified, so they spent their effort probing rather than rediscovering. This reading is UNTESTED speculation, not a measured causal claim.

quality.laundering_detected: 0/4 (v1 of the booster falsely flagged 2/2 capsule trials; root-caused and fixed — see RUN-NOTE 'WHAT SURPRISED')
quality.headline: NO QUALITY DIFFERENCE BETWEEN MODES ON THIS CORPUS. Both modes saturated the oracle.

cross_mode_difference.result: tsc 7.0.2 --strict reports only 2 errors, both type-level (repeat arity / void return). None of the four planted value-domain contract violations are compile errors: retryBudget(-5), summarizeBuckets([]), mean([]) and fastClassify(0) all type-check clean.
cross_mode_difference.verdict: SINGLE_OBSERVATION_N2 — reported by 1 trial; independently reproduced by the project lead. Not a rate, not generalisable.
